I am a registered patient at this practice and found absolutely nightmare.
I have extremely hyperglycaemia but struggled  to book appointment for the last 7 months to review my medications.
Despite the instructions from hospital my insulin prescription is not done on time.
After waiting for nearly 8 months of times the consultant changed my insulin but it was not put on repeat and I was without insulin for again.
I am heartbroken to observe my GP's negligence, it was breaches of his duty of care causing avoidable harm and unnecessary suffering through errors.

I suffered for the last 8 months in hyperglycaemia and feeling thirsty , urinating day and nights.

In result of this negligence I could have a diabetic coma and Boluward medical practice would face the consequences.

I suggest that public at large need to stand against this highly irresponsible act of their part.

At Boluward there is no-one to take your complaint seriously, untrained staff act reluctantly.
The only answer we as patients get that GP is not available and the manager is busy in meeting.

Most of the doctors are partners of this Boluward MP which is wrong because patients can't raise formal complaint with neutral person.

The patients are scared and they don't feel comfortable to speak against this malpractice and unethical behaviour.

I want the highest authorise to take action against this great negligence and terminate the person who is held responsible after a thoroughly investigation because the standards of service is down to earth here.

A doctor needs to understand that healthy community contribute to the economy and it can only happen when doctor diagnose their illnesses and provide treatment on time.

However, when most of the acting GPs are own their surgery then rights of patients get compromised and this is the situation here.

I hope someone at this practice will take a notice of patient's concerns and address this serious issue.

Best Regards
